purpose: Real-data fixtures for scripts/test_below_score_export.cjs (goatai#1885, GOAT-EA BS42, Claude-Mac line review 6025359910 items 5 and 6). Read-only copies; never regenerated by a test.

real-AUDUSD-Trds184.csv.what: A real EA export equity CSV (UTF-16LE, tab separated, DATE/BALANCE/EQUITY...), byte-identical copy.

real-AUDUSD-Trds287.csv.what: The second unit of the same AUDUSD member, byte-identical copy. With Trds184 it pins the daily BALANCE-close correlation over the days both curves logged.

mt5-profitable-zero-equity-dd-row.xml.what: Trimmed: the report's document header, its header row and its one profitable 'Equity DD %' = 0 row, each verbatim (re-encoded UTF-8). The Recovery Factor cell (0.62376238) is what the ranking divides profit by, so a zero equity DD does not divide by zero and the 0.25%-of-deposit floor decides the key.
mt5-profitable-zero-equity-dd-row.xml.scan: Across 6,410 real report XMLs on this PC, no profitable row had Recovery Factor <= 0 or >= 100; this SeedFarming frame row is the only profitable row with Equity DD % = 0.
